emptyText: Find your business on Google Maps by its name and district. Once chosen, follow where it shows from every point of a grid around it, the businesses beating it and its reviews.
findHint: Type its name on Google with its district or city; its Google id as cid:… works too.
foundHint: The business profile on Google for “{query}”
notFound: No business profile was found by this name. Try the name as on Google, with its district.
profileHint: Rating, opening hours, categories and what reviews talk about; the rating of the day it is read joins the history
competitorsTitle: Businesses of the same kind nearby
competitorsHint: Businesses of the same category within {km} km, most reviewed first
competitorsCount: {n} businesses in this area; the {shown} most reviewed are shown.
arpHelp: Your business's average place at the points where it shows; lower is better.
atrpHelp: The average over every point, counting points where it does not show as 21st.
top3Of: In the top 3 at {n} of {total} points
gridPlannedHint: After the first check, your business's place shows at every point
noRunText: No check yet. “Check the grid now” shows your place at every point.
gridLabel: Map grid, north at the top
pickPoint: Click a point to see who shows in the top three there.
mapFailed: The map could not load; after the first check the grid shows as squares.
rivalsTitle: Who beats you in the local pack
rivalsHint: The businesses most often in the top three at the grid's points
noRivals: No other business showed in the top three.
trendOne: The trend shows after the second check.
reviewsHint: Reviews are read through DataForSEO's standard queue; the answers arrive within minutes
reviewsAsked: Reviews asked for; they show here within minutes
reviewsWaiting: Reviews are waiting in the queue; the page refreshes when they arrive.
ratingTrendOne: The trend shows as the rating is read on different days.
noReviewsText: “Read reviews” brings your business's newest reviews. Scheduled grid checks read the newest reviews too.
replyHint: Edit it, copy it and answer on Google.
replyCopyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it
replyPositive: Thank you so much for your kind review! We are delighted you enjoyed your visit and look forward to welcoming you again.
replyNeutral: Thank you for your review. We have shared your suggestions with our team and hope to make your next visit even better.
replyNegative: We are truly sorry about your experience. Our team is looking into it; if you would like to share the details, please contact us directly. We would love the chance to make it right.
replyAi: or have an assistant write it:
